arbiter.summary: Parameterized arbiter: two priority encoders (plain and round-robin-masked) pick a requester; registered one-hot grant, valid and encoded index, with optional blocking until acknowledge.

axis_adapter.summary: AXI-stream width upsizer (8 to 32 bit): a segment counter packs input beats into an output register lane by lane, with a one-beat input skid buffer while the output is stalled.

anchors.why: Narrow input beat written into the selected output segment or skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; advances segment counter or loads skid buffer.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready, asserted while the skid buffer is empty.

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-packet sideband forcing early output of partial word.

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Input user sideband captured into output register.

anchors.name: upsize.s_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer holding one input beat while output is stalled.

anchors.name: upsize.s_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer full flag: selects buffer as source, deasserts tready.

blocks.name: Segment packer

blocks.name: Output AXI-stream register

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid, set when last segment or tlast packed.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output ready; gates all output register and skid updates.

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-packet from m_axis_tlast_reg.

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Output byte-valid mask built per segment for partial words.

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Output user sideband from m_axis_tuser_reg.
